items.headline: $ZEC ETF Plans 3-for-1 Split After $233M Inflow Surge
items.summary: Grayscale's $ZEC ETF nears $890M in assets as the privacy coin's rally pushes mining competition to record highs.

items.headline: $MORPHO Opens Borrowing Against Coinbase Stock Tokens
items.summary: Holders of five Coinbase tokenized stocks can now pledge them for USDC loans on Base via $MORPHO — a fresh DeFi use case for RWAs.

items.headline: $CANTON Tops Blockchain Fee Rankings With $60M in 30 Days
items.summary: Digital Asset's institutional chain $CANTON outpaced Tron and Ethereum in monthly fees, signaling surging onchain activity.

items.headline: $SOPH Kills Its zkSync Chain, Rebuilds on Base
items.summary: After raising $60M but drawing under 200 daily users, $SOPH is shutting its L2 and pivoting to a consumer app studio on Base.

items.headline: Polymarket Hires Ex-$ZORA CEO for Onchain Push
items.summary: Polymarket taps the former $ZORA chief as it rebuilds its central limit order book in Rust for a full onchain product overhaul.
